isRelatedTo.description:
Your captain for the day awaits you at Quai Saint Erasme, ready to welcome you on board for an unforgettable morning. Once the introductions have been made, let yourself be carried away by the sweet scent of freshly baked pastries and the captivating atmosphere of the sea spray.

Rates:

• 2 hours: $350

If you like brunches under the sun and by the sea, this experience is for you.

Imagine a sea of oil, absolute calm lulled by the first rays of the sun. It is at the heart of this show that we offer you the opportunity to enjoy a delicious breakfast in complete peace and quiet.

Crispy pastries to accompany your coffee, fresh bread, orange juice, jam, but also yogurts, scrambled eggs and a homemade preparation based on avocado and salmon to delight your taste buds. There is something for everyone, enough to wake you up dazzled and with a full stomach!

In addition, for an even more gourmet experience, you have the possibility of adding additional options such as a platter of fresh fruit, cold meats and/or cheese, to complete your breakfast and satisfy all your desires.

If you are reading these lines while sipping your coffee, let yourself be mentally transported to the deep blue of the sea, the gentle murmur of the waves and the comforting rays of the sun.

And the icing on the cake? A delicious breakfast that allows you to start the day in style, savored in an idyllic setting.

Don't hesitate any longer, treat yourself to a total disconnection!
